These beginner-friendly stretches can be done daily at home on a yoga mat to help improve flexibility, release tight piriformis and hamstring muscles, and restore pain-free movement.
What You’ll Practice:
• Cat-Cow Stretch – Mobilize the spine & ease lumbar stiffness
• Seated Spinal Twist – Gently release lower back & glute tension
• Knee-to-Shoulder Stretch – Ease piriformis & deep hip pressure
• Knees-to-Chest Pose (Apanasana) – Relax and decompress the sacrum
• Reclining Pigeon Pose (Figure 4) – Target the deep hip rotators
